{{Infobox Mechanic |image= {{Media |Model TotK= [[File:TotK Rain Model.png|320x320px]] |Sprite BotW= File:BotW Rain Icon.png |Screenshot OoT= File:Escapezelda.jpg |Screenshot OoT3D= File:OoT3D Rain.png |Screenshot MM= File:MM Rain.png |Screenshot MM3D= File:MM3D Rain.png |Screenshot TWW= File:TWW Rain.png |Screenshot TWWHD= File:TWWHD Rain.png |Screenshot TP= File:TP Rain.png |Screenshot TPHD= File:TPHD Rain.png |Screenshot BotW= File:BotW Rain.png |Screenshot TotK= File:TotK Rain.png |Screenshot EoW= File:EoW Rain.png }} |caption= |pronunciation= |game= OoT, MM, TWW, TP, BotW, TotK, EoW |other= AST |purpose= |related= }} {{Term/Store|Rain||Series, TWW, TWWHD, BotW, TotK}} is recurring weather event in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= E |publisher= |page= 260 {{Exp Game|TWW}}}}{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 26}}{{Cite Guide|TotK Piggyback|page= 29}}{{Name Ref|EoW}} Rain can often occur naturally, or it can be summoned with [[Item]]s. ==Overview== ==={{OoT|-}}=== In {{OoT}}, playing the "[[Song of Storms]]" on the [[Ocarina of Time (Item)|Ocarina of Time]] will summon rain and trigger certain events, such as filling the [[Desert Colossus]] oasis. Rain and wind will appear even if the Song is played indoors. ==={{MM|-}}=== In {{MM}}, playing the "Song of Storms" on the [[Ocarina of Time (Item)|Ocarina of Time]] will summon rain and trigger certain events. Rain and wind will appear even if the song is played indoors. [[Clock Town]], the [[Swamp Fishing Hole]] and the [[Ocean Fishing Hole]] will experience rain on the [[Second Day]] from 7AM to 12AM. Rain will cause the [[Termina Loach]] to swim near the water's surface and the [[Goodta Goby]] to swim deeper underwater, making them easier to catch with standard lure and sinking lure respectively. ==={{TWW|-}}=== {{Stub|TWW}} ==={{TP|-}}=== In {{TP}}, after [[Zant]] injures [[Midna]] and [[Link]] must carry her to [[Princess Zelda]], it is raining on the way to [[Hyrule Castle]]. Additionally, upon entering [[Hyrule Castle (Dungeon)|Hyrule Castle]] to battle [[Ganondorf]], it is raining in the courtyard. Rain has no effect on Link.{{Fact}} ==={{BotW|-}}=== In {{BotW}}, Rain will randomly occur in warmer [[Region]]s, and it makes surfaces become slick. This makes them difficult to [[Climbing|Climb]], as [[Link]] will periodically slip and fall. Rain will immediately extinguish any exposed [[Fire]]s, with the exception of [[Blue Flame]]s. Fires that are sheltered from the Rain are not affected. Empty shelters can be found alongside roads, and Link can create temporary shelters on [[Waterfall]]s using the [[Cryonis]] [[Rune]], as Rain will not penetrate the blocks it creates. [[Zora's Domain]] and the surrounding region will permanently experience rain until [[Divine Beast Vah Ruta]] has been purged of [[Waterblight Ganon]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Rain occurs during [[Thunderstorm]]s. ==={{EoW|-}}=== {{Stub|EoW}} Rain is summoned by the croaking of [[Drippitune]]s, which are common in the [[Faron Wetlands]]. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AST|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Stub|AST}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==Trivia== * "Zaa'va" is Rain in the [[Gerudo (Language)|Gerudo]] language.{{Cite|Hmm, I think the word for rain is...
